# Flisk Skills

> Portable Agent Skills (`SKILL.md`) and `AGENTS.md` rule templates for working with the Flisk CLI: a local-only, Docker + Tilt development tool. Not a deployment tool; do not invent Kubernetes or Docker Compose for Flisk projects.

Run `flisk doctor`, then `flisk up`, from the project root. One maintained copy of each skill lives under `skills/`; the Claude plugin and `.agents/skills/` are symlinks to it.

## Skills

- [flisk-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-doctor/SKILL.md): check or repair the environment and project configuration before `flisk up`
- [flisk-troubleshoot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-troubleshoot/SKILL.md): diagnose a failed `flisk up`, Docker or Tilt session
- [layer-autoresearch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/layer-autoresearch/SKILL.md): contributor experiment loop for the L1-L4 Docker layers
- [flisk-scaffold](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-scaffold/SKILL.md): scaffold new backends, frontends, agents and MCP servers
- [flisk-generated-files](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-generated-files/SKILL.md): understand and manage `.autogenerated/` files and drift
- [flisk-agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-agents/SKILL.md): run AI agents + MCP tools + database in one local stack
- [flisk-ai-agent-build](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-ai-agent-build/SKILL.md): scaffold a complete local agent system (agent + MCP + DB + queue)
- [flisk-data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-data/SKILL.md): reset, seed and snapshot local Postgres data
- [flisk-databases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-databases/SKILL.md): work with Postgres, Prisma, Drizzle, Atlas, Dbmate
- [flisk-benchmark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-benchmark/SKILL.md): measure container scale, idle memory and start times
- [flisk-ports](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-ports/SKILL.md): port selection, Traefik routing and localhost URLs
- [flisk-upgrade](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-upgrade/SKILL.md): upgrade the CLI and handle generated-file drift
- [flisk-byo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-byo/SKILL.md): bring-your-own resources and existing services
- [flisk-import-compose](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-import-compose/SKILL.md): import a root docker-compose.yml into Flisk with `flisk import`
- [flisk-import-any](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-import-any/SKILL.md): bring any existing Dockerfile, image or process into Flisk as BYO
- [flisk-import-procfile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-import-procfile/SKILL.md): turn Procfile processes into Flisk BYO resources
- [flisk-import-helm](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-import-helm/SKILL.md): use Flisk locally next to an existing Helm chart
- [flisk-secrets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-secrets/SKILL.md): project `.env`, params and secrets
- [flisk-layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-layout/SKILL.md): multi-repo layouts and ownership patterns
- [flisk-helm](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-helm/SKILL.md): use Flisk locally alongside Helm for production
- [flisk-deploy-alongside](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-alongside/SKILL.md): work with Helm, Argo CD, Kustomize and cloud hosts
- [flisk-deploy-aws](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-aws/SKILL.md): complete separate skill — deploy to AWS (ECS/EKS/App Runner/Lambda)
- [flisk-deploy-vercel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-vercel/SKILL.md): complete separate skill — deploy frontend/services to Vercel
- [flisk-deploy-gcp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-gcp/SKILL.md): complete separate skill — deploy to Google Cloud (Cloud Run/GKE)
- [flisk-deploy-azure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-azure/SKILL.md): complete separate skill — deploy to Azure (Container Apps/AKS)
- [flisk-deploy-railway](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-railway/SKILL.md): complete separate skill — deploy to Railway
- [flisk-deploy-fly](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-fly/SKILL.md): complete separate skill — deploy to Fly.io
- [flisk-deploy-render](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-render/SKILL.md): complete separate skill — deploy to Render
- [flisk-frontend](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-frontend/SKILL.md): frontend scaffolding and generated Vite/nginx configs
- [flisk-python](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-python/SKILL.md): Python backend services
- [flisk-build-runtimes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-build-runtimes/SKILL.md): Bun, Node, Python, Go, Rust, React, Vue, Svelte, Elysia, Fastify, NestJS
- [flisk-ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-ui/SKILL.md): interactive terminal dashboard (`tdk ui`)
- [flisk-dry-run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-dry-run/SKILL.md): preview stacks with `flisk up --dry-run`
- [flisk-examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-examples/SKILL.md): start from the official runnable examples
- [flisk-service-json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-service-json/SKILL.md): edit and validate the service.json contract
- [flisk-networks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-networks/SKILL.md): inspect routed URLs and stack topology
- [flisk-doctor-verbose](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-doctor-verbose/SKILL.md): deep diagnostic runs with extra verbosity
- [flisk-contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-contributing/SKILL.md): guide for contributors working on flisk
- [flisk-pr-review-buttons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-pr-review-buttons/SKILL.md): add "Review this PR in" Grok, Claude and Codex buttons to a repo's pull requests

## Rules templates

- [AGENTS.landscape.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/rules/AGENTS.landscape.md): for Flisk project, example and starter repos
- [AGENTS.cli-core.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/rules/AGENTS.cli-core.md): for contributors to flisk

## Install

- [README](https://github.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/blob/main/README.md): `npx skills add flisk-sh/flisk-skills`, or `install.sh --agent claude|codex|opencode|cursor|agents`
- [SPEC](https://github.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/blob/main/SPEC.md): layout and discovery paths

- [Flisk docs](https://flisk.sh/docs/quickstart/): quick start and configuration
- [Flisk llms.txt](https://flisk.sh/llms.txt): index of the Flisk site, docs and reference landscapes
- [flisk](https://github.com/flisk-sh/flisk): the CLI source and `cli/README.md` command reference
